friction: Hybrid airframe overrides (structural factor, prop diameter) have no config key; aircraft_data supplied alongside aircraft_template was silently ignored (identical results).
operating_points keys like 'ac|propulsion|engine|rating' validated OK but were silently ignored for the ocp/FullMission run.
initial_values are silently ignored in analysis mode, and unknown names (e.g. 'bogus|path', 'ac|weights|structural_fudge') raise no error or warning.

Structural factor is not an 'ac|' variable. It exists as a separate input '<phase>.OEW.structural_fudge' in each of the 8 phases; margins.MTOW_margin does not use climb.OEW, so setting only one copy changed nothing. Had to set all 8 copies. I found this by guessing names in get_results.
The first optimization runs (v1 and v2 plans) used the wrong or partial structural factor and gave invalid results (objective ~342.68); they were discarded.
No tool lists model variable names; get_results(summary=true) output was too large to read without filesystem access.

run_plan in optimize mode always hit the 60 s MCP client timeout, while the run kept going server-side. Run IDs had to be found via get_provenance, and waiting required repeated dummy probe runs as a sleep, since no wait tool exists.
Concurrent runs share CPU on the server, so runs took ~15 min instead of ~2.5 min.
get_results(variables=...) returns every driver iteration and cannot return only the final case, so the output overflowed with 15 variables and queries had to be split.
Two battery-heavy start runs finished with status 'failed' and no recorded cases or error message.
Mixed objective name 'mixed_objective' was accepted by the validator, but I only found it by guessing; it is not documented in omd://reference.
record_conclusion gave verdict 'partial' because the plan has no requirements.
